title: Adam is created
description: Creation of Adam and Eve in Eden; Genesis 3:15 pronounces the first Messianic promise.

title: The Global Flood
description: 1,656 years after Adam's creation, Jehovah brings the Global Flood; Noah's family of 8 survives in the ark.

title: Abraham crosses the Euphrates
description: 427 years after the Flood, Abraham enters Canaan and the 430-year covenant period begins (Galatians 3:17).

title: Isaac weaned — '400 years of affliction' begins
description: At age 5 Isaac is weaned and mocked by Ishmael, starting the 400-year affliction foretold at Genesis 15:13.

title: Israel settles in Egypt
description: Jacob (Israel) moves his household of 70 into Goshen during the great famine under Prime Minister Joseph.

title: Moses leads the Exodus from Egypt
description: Exactly 430 years after 1943 B.C.E., Jehovah delivers Israel from Egypt and inaugurates the Law Covenant at Sinai.

title: Saul begins to rule as king in Israel
description: After 356 years of the Judges, Samuel anoints Saul of Benjamin as Israel's first human king.

title: Kingdom of Israel splits into two
description: Following Solomon's death, the nation splits into Northern Israel and Southern Judah for 390 years (Ezekiel 4:5).

title: Assyria destroys Northern Israel
description: The Assyrian Empire conquers Samaria and exiles the ten-tribe northern kingdom; David's line endures in Judah.

title: Babylon destroys Judah and Jerusalem
description: Nebuchadnezzar destroys Jerusalem and Solomon's temple, ending 510 years of Israelite kings.

title: Medo-Persia conquers Babylon
description: Cyrus the Great overthrows Babylon overnight, setting the stage for Jewish liberation and Daniel's 70-weeks prophecy.

title: Jews return under Governor Zerubbabel
description: Under Cyrus' decree, a faithful remnant returns to Jerusalem led by Zerubbabel — key ancestor in both Matthew 1 and Luke 3.

title: Esther and Mordecai save the Jews
description: In the Persian court, Queen Esther and Mordecai foil Haman's decree, safeguarding the Messianic nation.

title: Order to rebuild Jerusalem — 70 Weeks begin
description: Artaxerxes authorizes Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem's walls, launching Daniel 9:25's 69-week (483-year) countdown to Messiah.

title: Jerusalem is completely rebuilt
description: 7 prophetic weeks (49 years) after 455 B.C.E., Jerusalem's restoration is completed.

title: Greece becomes dominant world power
description: Alexander the Great defeats Persia, spreading Koine Greek — the future language of the Christian Greek Scriptures.

title: Rome becomes dominant world power
description: Rome annexes Egypt and rules the Mediterranean world, preparing the census that brings Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem.

title: The birth of Jesus in Bethlehem
description: Born in Bethlehem of Judea to Mary (Luke 3) and adopted by Joseph (Matthew 1), fulfilling Micah 5:2 and Luke 1:32.

title: Jesus baptized — becomes the Promised Offspring
description: Exactly 483 years (69 prophetic weeks) after 455 B.C.E. (with no year zero!), Jesus is baptized by John and anointed as Messiah.
